__comment: WEB'S OWN COPY of a realistic GET /schools/:id/accreditation/twin response.
THE CONTRACT LIVES AT apps/api/src/twin/__fixtures__/twin.example.json — that file is
owned by ENGINEER-API and is the authority. This copy exists so the accreditation
components can be read, reviewed and (later) specced without a running API. If the two
ever disagree, the API file wins and this one is wrong.
SHAPE NOTES the components depend on:
· findings[] is FindingPublic: TwinFinding + the ledger lifecycle. `id === null` means
the rule is firing right now but tonight's reconciliation has not written the row yet
— the UI shows the finding and DISABLES ack with 'This will be recorded tonight.'
· likelihood is the WORD 'possible' | 'likely'. Never a number, never a percentage.
· horizon.kind 'none' is a legitimate, common answer; horizon.reason is then non-null
and is rendered verbatim in the timeline's 'No date we can honestly give' column.
· notEvaluated[] always names blockingSignalKey/Label (null only for 'no_standards')
and carries the signal's own message plus the unlock that would close it.
· domainBands is ALWAYS all ten domains in the frozen order; band === null means NOT
MEASURED and reason is then non-null (grey with a reason, never grey with a number).
· perStandardRisk[].risk === null is NOT a risk of zero — reason says why.
· signals[] is the collected roster, one row per catalog signal, and /twin now
ALWAYS carries it (EarlyWarningService adds it from the set it just prepared).
SignalCoverageTable keeps its degraded fallback for an older payload: counts plus
the blocked signals named in notEvaluated[] — it never invents a row.

horizon.reason: This is a condition today, not a projection.

findings.consequence: Assurances are pass or fail. An unmet one is not a low score — it is the accreditation blocked until it is met.

findings.title: The financial audit on file is no longer current
findings.rationale: The most recent financial audit on file stopped being current on 30 June 2026 — 32 days ago — and 2 standards cite it.
findings.consequence: The external audit is a binary assurance in Cognia and a named artifact in MSA and NSBECS; a lapsed one is the single fastest finding a visiting team can write.

findings.title: Operating margin is falling across the recorded years
findings.rationale: Operating margin has fallen across 5 readings, FY2022 to FY2026 — from 6.0% to 1.5%, about 1.5 percentage points a year (Mann-Kendall p = 0.0167).
findings.consequence: Financial sustainability is a resource-allocation finding, and a multi-year direction is the form of it a visiting team writes up rather than notes.

findings.title: The adopted strategic plan is inside its final year
findings.rationale: The adopted strategic plan ends on 30 June 2027, 333 days from now.
findings.consequence: Every framework asks for a current plan and its evidence of implementation; a plan takes about a year to write, which is why this warns at twelve months and not at ninety days.
findings.mutedReason: Board reviews the successor plan in September
